name: The Other Doors

levels.entry: A second doorway, out past the salt, framed in the same dressed basalt as the swept one.
No path to it. Nobody sweeps it and nobody warns you off it either.
Same courses, same joints, same stone. Built by whoever built the other, and not later.
Pell says there are more. Says it the way you would say there are more wells.
So the Gate Court is not the gate. It is the one they kept, and keeping one and abandoning the rest is a decision somebody made and nobody remembers making.
